text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak and United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan meet in Abu Dhabi for talks on the peace process, and joint cooperation in investment and agriculture. Mubarak tells newspaper editors that Egypt concluded $10 billion in investment deals during the Middle East and North Africa Economic Conference.
- Mubarak declares the conference a success and orders the formation of a committee to follow it up.
- Mubarak sends condolences to Saudi Arabia for the crash of the Saudi airliner over India this week.
- Cabinet is to convene a special session to follow up the results of the economic conference. It will be headed by Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri.
- Mubarak congratulates Sheikh Zaid on the success of his recent surgery in the United States.

- Mubarak tells the Financial Times in an interview that Israeli settlements around Jerusalem are a time bomb and that Netanyahu must make a decision, though it be difficult. He said not withdrawing Israeli troops from Hebron could lead to renewed violence.
